summary: W16 CLOSED 8-9 (Build deload). Delivered 2 runs (~8.7 mi) + 1 Z1 row + 2 lifts — both quality sessions and both lifts banked, ZERO easy running, against a ~14 mi deload target. The back half reshaped twice: Adj #242/#243 on 8-7, then Adj #250 on 8-8 when the Sat VO2 went unperformed and moved to Sun, dropping the 50-min long (§11.D, no slot before v4.4). Sun's VO2 ran 4×3 @ I at 6:41/6:44/7:03/7:00 — reps 1-2 inside the R band — with WALKED recoveries (14:32/13:45/17:00) instead of the prescribed jog, and the athlete read it as "pretty easy, could've done 3 more at 7:00" against a 9 anchor. That is the third consecutive sub-anchor I read and the strongest, but it is doubly confounded by the walked recoveries (Adj #252) and the shortest I dose of the Build, so the band 7:00–7:15 STANDS per the Adj #202 no-recalc-outside-tests posture. The decisive test is W17 Fri 8-14: 5×1000m @ I, open at the 7:00 fast end, 90 s JOG recoveries, full dose — sub-anchor there reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251). Cadence came back sub-band at I (173/174/168/171) — the Adj #241 clear reads threshold-specific, watch re-armed (Adj #253). Running power on record for the first time (294/284/280/286 W), datum only. All clean by default — ninth straight quality outing clean; the ~40 h post-sweep Achilles read closed clean and the calf 365 gate reads Mon 8-17. W17 opens Mon 8-10 as the first v4.4 three-run week: Mon LONG 70 min + 4-6 hill strides / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 6×1K / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 5×1000m / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. Monday is the week's entire easy fraction and does not move; hill strides fire post-long, unperformed since W10 (Adj #236). Lift gates into W17: incline repeats 155 Tue (Adj #237), elbow 2nd-movement decision at the Tue brief (Adj #229), DB lateral 40 and seated calf 365 both fire Sat 8-15 (Adj #248/#249).
